mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, analysis_year_month, target_year_month, total_spending, saving_target_amount, actual_saving_amount, saving_difference_amount, saving_result_message, report_status, report_viewed_at, report_closed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM monthly_spending_analyses WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND target_year_month = #{targetYearMonth} LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM monthly_spending_analyses WHERE id = #{monthlySpendingAnalysisId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT mcs.id, mcs.monthly_spending_analysis_id, mcs.category_id, sc.category_code, sc.category_name, mcs.reduction_rate, mcs.baseline_spending_amount, mcs.monthly_reduction_target, mcs.monthly_usage_target, mcs.created_at, mcs.updated_at FROM mission_category_selections mcs JOIN spending_categories sc ON sc.id = mcs.category_id WHERE mcs.monthly_spending_analysis_id = #{monthlySpendingAnalysisId} ORDER BY mcs.category_id

SELECT msm.id, msm.user_id, msm.monthly_spending_analysis_id, msm.mission_category_selection_id, msm.category_id, sc.category_code, sc.category_name, msm.target_year_month, msm.reduction_rate, msm.baseline_spending_amount, msm.monthly_reduction_target, msm.monthly_usage_target, msm.planned_saving_amount, msm.start_week, msm.status, msm.created_at, msm.updated_at FROM monthly_saving_missions msm JOIN spending_categories sc ON sc.id = msm.category_id WHERE msm.user_id = #{userId} AND msm.target_year_month = #{targetYearMonth} ORDER BY msm.id

SELECT id, monthly_saving_mission_id, week_number, period_start_date, period_end_date, weekly_usage_limit, weekly_expected_saving, actual_spending, actual_saving, status, evaluated_at, created_at, updated_at FROM weekly_saving_missions WHERE monthly_saving_mission_id = #{monthlySavingMissionId} ORDER BY week_number
mapper.update: UPDATE monthly_spending_analyses SET report_status = 'CLOSED', report_closed_at = COALESCE(report_closed_at, NOW()), updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND analysis_year_month = #{analysisYearMonth} AND report_status IN ('PENDING', 'VIEWED')
